job.organization: South Orange County Community College District

items.item_text: The following duties are typical for this classification. Incumbents may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs and changing business practices.
Greet and assist students, visitors, and members of the public at the front desk; provide information and assistance or refer individuals to the appropriate staff member or campus office.
Answer telephone calls and respond to email inquiries from current and prospective international students, applicants, and members of the public.
Provide general information regarding international student admissions, enrollment, college services, and office procedures.
Assist with processing international student applications and collecting, reviewing, organizing, and tracking required documentation in accordance with established procedures.
Assist with the preparation and distribution of immigration-related documents, including I-20 forms, under established procedures and the direction of appropriate staff.
Enter, update, and retrieve student information in college computer systems; maintain accurate and organized electronic and paper records.
Assist with monitoring application and documentation status and follow up on missing or incomplete information as directed.
Assist with scheduling and coordinating student orientations, cultural activities, workshops, and other international student programs and events.
Assist with event preparation, including room setup, materials preparation, registration, check-in, and related logistical activities.
Prepare and distribute flyers, emails, announcements, and other informational materials to promote programs, services, and events.
Communicate and coordinate with Admissions, Counseling, Student Services, and other campus departments to assist with international student needs and referrals.
Assist with preparing reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, forms, and other office materials.
Provide general administrative support, including filing, scanning, copying, data entry, and maintaining office supplies and materials.
Maintain confidentiality and handle student and other sensitive information in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Basic office practices, procedures, and customer service principles.
General college admissions, enrollment, and student support services, particularly those affecting international students.
Basic concepts related to international student admissions and immigration documentation; training will be provided.
Basic recordkeeping and data-entry practices.
Common computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, email, internet browsers, and electronic file management.
Professional telephone, email, and interpersonal communication practices.
Principles of confidentiality and appropriate handling of student information..
Provide effective customer service to individuals from diverse cultural, linguistic, and educational backgrounds.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, administrators, and members of the public.
Organize work, establish priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records.
Follow established procedures and instructions and seek clarification when necessary.
Accurately enter, retrieve, and maintain information using computer systems and standard office applications.
Exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality when handling student records and sensitive information.
Work effectively as a member of a team and independently with general supervision.
Assist with the coordination and implementation of student programs, orientations, and events.
Adapt to changing priorities and work assignments.
Report to work on a regular and consistent basis, as scheduled, to assigned job.
WORKING ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Work is usually performed in an office setting at the college. Regular contact with students, staff, and members of the public. May be asked to help with occasional evening or weekend events. Work involves sitting for long periods while using a computer. May need to lift and carry materials or supplies (up to 25 pounds). Frequent talking, listening, and using hands for typing and writing. Moving around campus to support events or deliver documents.
Skills and Abilities to:
Communicate clearly, professionally, and courteously in person, by telephone, and in writing.
Operate standard office equipment, including computers, printers, scanners, and related equipment.
